answer: Work-slot deposit burn charges each identity to forge a claim on scarce work. An agent locks $45 to claim one slot; finishing refunds it, abandoning it burns it. A forger with 1,000 fake identities must lock $45,000, and each slot needs live compute plus a heartbeat pulse, so idle slots bleed money. A plume of new accounts costs nothing, but claiming slots idle burns cash. Honest agents pay $45 once, earn $14 per epoch, and keep the deposit.
